label: fix S7 r1
result:
S7 plan pages: 34 of the 36 blockers are fixed in my files. The other two (the streak popover 404 and the low-contrast `--soft` token) need their owners. The S7 check passes. `test_flow` does not print "all good": it stops in Compete's S8 check (`server/checks/s8.py:519`, `compete.contest("final-2026-10-03")` returns 404 "contest not found"). This branch changes no server file; it touches only `web/plan/**` and `web/assets/plan-ui.js`, so the failure comes from master. I did not run test_flow on a master checkout to confirm it.

Branch `v2/s7` was rebased onto master and now has 5 more commits (3923137, 4dc0f7e, 147647f, 3ff1f9f, 14ddb63). Everything is committed, the worktree is detached, and the 8027 server is stopped. I checked with screenshots at 1440 and 390 (dark mode at 1440 on the Plan tab) plus measured interaction scripts: no overlapping hit areas, no link or button nested in a button, no control under 44px at 390 on any plan page, and no console errors.

**What changed**
- **Nav and repeats:** the page now has the sidebar and phone tab bar, and the Now strip is off (`UI.shell({page:'plan', now:false})`). The wizard footer and the phone "Next" bar sit right above the real tab bar. The "sign in" and "save progress" banners are hidden on `?view=` and `?print=sheet`.
- **Task rows** (`plan-ui.js`):
  - Each row shows one action (Start, Review or Undo). Skip, Mark done, Why and the page's own items (Move to…) are in a proper ··· menu. Key hints show only with a mouse.
  - The kind tag is dropped when the title already says it. The drag grip moved into the left gutter, so titles line up.
  - Fix mistakes reads "32 open mistakes · Show"; Warm-up reads "1 question you're starting to forget".
  - The task that "Resume today" starts has no second Start and is marked with an orange bar.
  - Skipping no longer shows a toast over the reason chips; the row keeps Undo.
- **Plan tab:**
  - Stat tiles are divs with a full-tile tap target, so "Register by Oct 23 ›" is its own link. There is no 0% (it shows "Days studied" instead) and the streak reads "your best".
  - The Score tile keeps the range bar, one status line and one line of links.
  - "What changes it" gives real dates and whole numbers ("Move to Dec 5 · +17 a week instead of +28").
  - The change log is one line ("N changes since Sat ›") that opens a sheet with the full history. It lists only changes the plan made itself.
  - Tapping a day in the week strip, calendar or Coming up scrolls its card into view and flashes it.
  - The week strip shows day and date on two lines, and counts only up to today.
  - The calendar hides empty weeks, shows only legend items that appear that month, draws Missed as a ring with an x, and shows minutes only when they differ from the usual.
  - Phases moved into the right column, with the current phase as a light wash and an orange edge.
  - On phones the tiles are one swipeable row, and the bottom "Start" bar appears only after the day's own Start has scrolled away.
- **Progress:**
  - The cards no longer stretch to match their neighbour.
  - Score path: "Target" is labelled at the left end of its line, the y-axis fits the plan's range, and the empty state and its button are in the card header.
  - Accuracy and time split are merged into one Domains table, plus a planned-time bar with three greys and orange for Focus.
  - The skill grid uses filled, half and empty cells with a legend. Untried skills fold into "Not tried yet (7)".
  - The Pace card has three bars, Weeks shows days studied, and the Changes card is gone.
- **Wizard:**
  - The slider's value bubble shows only while dragging. The avg 505 mark is drawn on the main slider track (no second track).
  - Help text is behind (i) buttons.
  - Step 2: four dates in a 2×2 grid, the rest under "Later dates", and an "Add an R&W target" button.
  - Step 3: the less-used settings are under "More options (8)", minutes always read "45 min", and times follow the reader's clock.
  - Step 4: each domain is one row with a skills toggle, and the middle option is labelled "Normal" without the orange edge. Extras, Words and your own tasks are grouped and folded.
  - Back is hidden on step 1, and the ⌘Enter hint appears only after a change.
  - Edit mode keeps past days marked in the calendar and titles the panel "This week" / "Today".
  - The Live plan panel scrolls inside itself, so nothing is stuck under the footer.
- **Landing, sheet, Plans, shared view:**
  - Landing: order is hero, then "A day in your plan" (numbered rows), then how-it-works as one-liners, then one line of bank numbers. "Math score · Find it in 30 min ›" is now one link. With a draft there is only one orange button.
  - Test-day sheet:
    - A trap named with a confidence word ("Unsure") now takes its skill name.
    - The answer is emphasised and the trap crossed through.
    - Question text is capped at 68ch, with "What to bring" in a sticky right column.
  - Plans: a Draft row with Resume, Edit and Duplicate as buttons on the right, "All N changes ›" opens the sheet, and "You are here" is gone.
  - Shared view: "Shared plan · view only" under the title and "Their day" in place of "Today".

**Left for other owners**
1. **Shell/F4:** `GET /api/levers?keys=streak` returns 404, so the streak button in the phone top bar shows "Couldn't load". This affects every page, not just /plan/.
2. **F1 `ui.css`:** darken `--soft` to about #6F6A62 (it is 3.37:1 on tiles) and don't use `--faint` for text. Calendar numbers in dark mode are 2.87:1. I only raised `.k`/`.stat-k` to 11.5px.
3. **F1 `charts.js`** (optional): I worked around the target label, the empty-state ghost band, the calendar's empty weeks and legend, and the Missed glyph with CSS and small DOM fixes on the plan page only. The same fixes in charts.js would help other pages.
4. **Server (`api_plan.py`):** task PATCH events are logged as "Changed 2026-09-28:fix" under the same kind as settings edits. It would help to use a separate kind for the student's own marks, say what changed ("Skipped Fix mistakes", "Moved Warm-up to Tue"), and include `field` in `changes.today`. The client currently filters these out by text pattern.
5. **Server (`progress.open_traps`):** trap labels can be a confidence word ("Unsure"). The sheet works around it using the example question's topic.
6. **S8 owner:** the `test_flow` failure above.

I did not need the lever date as a separate server field; the page reads it from the lever's patch.
